text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Walking into the cafeteria one lunchtime, I spot Mejiro Ardan with several plates of peculiar food in front of her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer. Take a look at this cuisine—not something you find every day, is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's an herbal dish that improves digestion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Apparently, the cafeteria has introduced it on a trial basis, but the flavor is so unique that hardly anybody orders it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It'd be a great shame to let food go to waste, and since my palate is accustomed to healthy food, I decided to order several servings.
choice_data_list: Don't you think this is a little much, though?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Slightly, yes. But I believe the additional nutrients will prove beneficial.
choice_data_list: You'll overdose on nutrients at this rate.
In that case, eat up and bulk up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's as I feared… I can't manage all of this. Yet I can't bear to waste any of it either…
choice_data_list: I'll help you finish the food.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now, please wait a moment while I calculate the appropriate portion size in terms of nutrition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan divides up the food, and I eat what she's not able to finish herself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. I will build up a figure capable of winning races, so please do look forward to my progress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan goes on to finish every last bite of the herbal cuisine, getting a healthy heaping of nutrition in the process.
